description: The until option skips a later stage without evaluating its computed empty delimiter (engine §10, §13).

documents.p.md:

%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%const $E ""
%rule text A
%conditions $.value.split($E ++ $E) = ∅
